name: Lateral lunge
summary: Step wide to one side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight, then push back.
setup: Face the phone, feet together. Step wide to the working side and sit the hips back over that foot, the other leg straight, then push back to the start.
brief: Feet together. Step wide to the working side and sit the hips back over that foot, the other leg straight, then push back to the start.
why: Facing the phone the knees move far apart on every step, so reps are counted; where the weight sits is listed rather than judged.
progression: Hold a dumbbell at the chest.
contraindications: Groin strain; knee pain on the bent side.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Bent knee caving inward
faults.tip: Sit back into the hip so the knee stays over the middle of the foot.

faults.label: Toes turning out
faults.tip: Turning the stepping foot out moves the work from the groin to the front of the hip.

faults.label: Toes turning out
faults.tip: Both feet point at the phone; the stretch is in the straight leg's inner thigh.

faults.label: Bending the trailing knee
faults.tip: The leg you are not sitting into stays straight; that is where the stretch belongs.

points.t: Knee over the foot; hips sit back.
Feet wide apart at the bottom.
